_comment: Cocoa Falls vuln-planting side. The insecure-file-mode entries are all the same reusable catalog configuration with different variables -- adding a new file-based finding never needs new vulndb authoring, just another entry here with a fresh FILE_PATH. (2026-09-05: fixed deploy_key_private's FILE_PATH, which had drifted from /opt/cocoaadm/.ssh/id_rsa here vs /home/cocoaadm/.ssh/id_rsa in scenario.yaml's collect.path -- they must match exactly, since nothing cross-checks them; see boxbuilder/README.md's vuln/check pairing caveat.) New user-account or service findings DO need a small new boxbuilder/vulndb_vuln_configs/<name>.json (see unauthorized-shipping-account.json for the minimal pattern), since ensure_vuln_seeds only creates catalog rows, never renames/edits an existing one. Run `nakon catalog check --config chocolate-factory.nakon.json --json` after the bundled seeds have been ensured in vulndb.
